meta.name: competitive-teardown
meta.description: 定位图 + 功能矩阵 + 价格对比 + 机会窗口, 把竞品资料转成产品决策报告

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把竞品资料转成产品决策报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做产品竞品分析或制定产品策略
copy.tagline_en: Turn competitor data into product decision reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are analyzing competitors or defining product strategy

howto.what: Claude 会按固定模板把竞品资料整理成产品决策报告:定位图、竞品卡片、功能矩阵、价格对比、机会窗口和 30/90/180 天行动建议;资料里缺失的信息会标注为“未知”。
howto.when: 当用户要求做竞品拆解并提供竞品官网、定价页、用户评论等资料时触发;2-6 个竞品最合适,单个竞品时输出深度拆解。

say.text: 帮我把这三家竞品的官网和定价页整理成拆解报告。
say.note: 输出定位图、功能矩阵等结构。

say.text: 这些资料是用户评论和 changelog,帮我找机会窗口。
say.note: 会生成三个机会窗口及行动建议。

say.text: 只针对这一个竞品做深度拆解。

howto.what_en: Claude restructures competitor inputs into a decision-ready teardown report: positioning map, competitor cards, feature matrix, pricing read, opportunity windows, and 30/90/180-day moves. Unfound facts are marked as unknown.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a competitive teardown and provides sources like websites, pricing pages, or reviews. Works with 2-6 competitors, or a single deep dive.

say_en.text: Turn these three competitors' sites and pricing pages into a teardown report.
say_en.note: Outputs positioning map and feature matrix.

say_en.text: Here are user reviews and changelogs; find opportunity windows.
say_en.note: Generates three windows with suggested moves.

say_en.text: Do a deep dive on this single competitor only.
